how: Colliers Wood Community Orchestra welcomes beginners and returners without audition, rehearsing on Tuesday evenings in term time with a free first session; many other open London amateur orchestras are listed by Making Music.
No kitesurfing spot exists in Greater London; the nearest schools are at Whitstable (Kent) and Camber Sands (East Sussex), roughly 1.5 hours away.

Perry's Butchers in east London teaches three-hour sausage-making workshops at weekends, and the Ginger Pig, Parson's Nose and the Cookery School at Little Portland Street also run butchery or sausage classes.
Listen & Learn offers one-to-one and small-group Tamil lessons with native tutors in London, in person or online; no community Tamil school was confirmed.
